description.value: Mongolie Grill is an independently owned stir-fry restaurant that has operated in the heart of Whistler Village since 1996. Diners select their own combination of meats, seafood, vegetables, and sauces, then watch the chefs cook the meal theatrically on a large open grill. The restaurant caters to a wide range of dietary needs and is consistently cited as one of Whistler's top dining experiences.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (8 spaces) at 72m. Total: 8 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully accessible and confirms an active, well-established stir-fry restaurant at 201-4295 Blackcomb Way in Whistler Village. The site explicitly mentions vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-free options with a 20% vegetarian discount. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, takeout, Wi-Fi, or cycling-specific amenities anywhere on the site; those fields default to null.
